newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Fiat Brazil unit to appeal environmental fine.
newsitem.headline: Fiat Brazil unit to appeal environmental fine.

text.p: Fiat SpA's local unit said it will appeal a decision by the Brazilian government's Environment Institute (IBAMA) to uphold a 3.9 million reais fine levied against the firm last year.
"Fiat's unit will continue to appeal, including possibly appealing to the Environment Ministry," said a company spokesman, who asked not to be named.
The fine was imposed against Fiat in November for producing nearly 500,000 Uno Mille model cars, which allegedly emitted more pollution than allowed under Brazilian law.
IBAMA's general attorney Vicente Gomes da Silva said the institute upheld the fine after an initial appeal by the auto giant.
Silva said Fiat first appealed in December, alleging that IBAMA had not respected all legislative procedures when it set the fine against the firm.
However, IBAMA dismissed Fiat's argument as irrelevant to the process, he said.
